notes: This is an Elephant and Piggie book by Mo Willems. The core joke of the story is that Gerald and Piggie keep realising they are missing something needed for the drive (sunglasses, a bag, a map), so problem-solving vocabulary is central. 'Excited' and 'ready' capture the emotional arc. 'Fun' is a key word as the drive itself represents desired fun. The hero slot should show both Gerald and Piggie together if possible, as both characters are equally central. Boardmaker generic elephant/pig icons will not match the distinctive Mo Willems art style — sourced clip art is strongly recommended.
